name: Kiroku Studio
description: A bold, kinetic theme for creative agencies, motion studios and brand designers: a near-black ground, white type and one neon green, Bricolage Grotesque headlines that stretch along their width axis over Figtree text. The wordmark sits top-left and the menu is a numbered index (01 Work, 02 Services…) in the corner of every title card. The home page scrolls sideways: a case-study reel that snaps card by card (swipe it, scroll it, or Tab in and use the arrow keys) with a progress line, then two marquee lines of type, service rows that fill green on hover, the studio and the journal in a sideways row. The footer ends in a giant wordmark that turns neon green, with a green bar sweeping in, when pointed at. With a work index whose rows slide their photograph in, four case studies, services with prices and a sideways process track, about with the team, a journal, a newsletter and contact; the studio's address, email, phone and social links are edited in one place. All motion is CSS and stops for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, the numbered index, card titles, numbers and the marquee lines (its width axis makes words stretch)
